__description: Built-in KBD orchestrator hooks. All entries in this file are tagged layer=builtin at load time. The 'report-progress' entry is the default reporter; a project can replace it by shipping a mode='override' entry covering '*:*' in .kbd-orchestrator/hooks-config.json.

hooks.description: Default reporter — emits 'starting/ending <kind> <name> [<i>/<n>]' to stderr on every dispatch.

action.command: if [ "$KBD_HOOK_EDGE" = "before" ]; then verb=starting; else verb=ending; fi; printf '%s %s %s [%s/%s]\n' "$verb" "$KBD_HOOK_KIND" "$KBD_HOOK_NAME" "$KBD_HOOK_INDEX" "$KBD_HOOK_TOTAL" >&2

hooks.description: Mirror every hook fire into surreal-memory (default-on when endpoint is reachable; no-op otherwise). Captures only structured KBD_HOOK_* values — no third-party stderr.
Populate prior-context.md from surreal-memory before each /kbd-assess. Composes with on_failure: ignore so a missing memory endpoint never blocks assess.

action.command: echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Phase complete — run /kbd-reflect to generate reflection report, then /kbd-new-phase to start next phase'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Change complete — update progress.json, then run /opsx:verify + /opsx:archive (if OpenSpec) or move to .kbd-orchestrator/changes/archive/ (if native KBD)'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Assessment written — run /kbd-plan to generate change list'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Plan written — run /kbd-execute to select backend and dispatch'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Cross-tool handoff — receiving tool should read current-waypoint.json and progress.json before starting'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Blocker detected — update progress.json status=BLOCKED, update waypoint fallback_command, commit .kbd-orchestrator/'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Reflection complete — waypoint advanced to next phase, run /kbd-new-phase <name> to begin'
